description: Land Title Settlement Department - Govindupura, Siyambalanduwa, D/S Division, Monaragala District - Cad. Map No. 720003 (23/0819)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Land Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and title classifications. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, title determinations, and property ownership matters.
